newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares extend gains after U.S. price data.
newsitem.headline: German shares extend gains after U.S. price data.

text.p: 1259 GMT - German shares extend gains in afternoon electronic trade after U.S. inflation data comes in tamer than expected. IBIS DAX index pops above key psychological threshold at 3,600 points, eyes U.S. open for next direction.
* IBIS DAX index up 33.08 points at 3,592.37, hits high of 3,601.64. DAX bourse close was 3,573.69 points.
* June DTB DAX futures up 34.5 points at 3,598.5.
* Deutsche Telekom continues to pare losses after Bonn stake sale shock.
* Dow Jones seen boosted by April inflation data.
